body.statement: When \(W=\varnothing\) and \(\Pi\) entails strict positivity of every observed cell over \(\prod_{i\in V}\Omega_i\), \(\operatorname{FID\text{-}S}(G,\Omega,W,\Pi,x,y)\) reduces to ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\): its successful expression agrees with the ordinary ID functional and every failure trace contains a corrected query-specific hedge.
body.justification: This is the mandatory sanity reduction and rules out an unrelated support calculus masquerading as causal identification.
body.gap: The correction in Shpitser's failure characterization makes the hedge query-specific; the reduction must preserve that corrected scope.
body.consumer: Existing users obtain the same answer as ordinary ID whenever no new functional or support information is supplied.

obligation.what_is_open: Showing that the as-yet unspecified productions of \(\operatorname{FID\text{-}S}\) specialize exactly to ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\), including the corrected query-specific hedge on every failure trace.
obligation.obstruction: The proposition depends on \(\mathrm{oeq:latent-lifting}\). The frozen definitions describe only a construction handle and do not define the grammar's transitions, terminal failure traces, or expression compiler. Equality with ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\) therefore has no rule-level object to prove against.
obligation.attempted: I checked whether strict positivity and \(W=\varnothing\) alone turn the frozen handles into the ordinary ancestral and district recursion. They do not specify which recursive state is retained or which query-specific hedge is emitted, so deriving the proposition would silently assume the missing crux.
obligation.partial_result: On causally sufficient inputs, the proved completion criterion is a finite support-sensitive formula-or-countermodel procedure.  On latent strictly positive inputs, however, \(\mathrm{def:trace-grammar-handle}\) and \(\mathrm{def:fids-handle}\) are construction handles rather than a specified production system.  Therefore there is not yet a defined failure trace from which to derive a corrected query-specific hedge, nor a defined successful expression to compare equation by equation with ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\).
